title: Frontend or backend?
instruction: A music app and the school system. What does the frontend on your phone do, and what does the backend on the server do?

items.text: The ▶ button and the playback animation
items.why: You see and control that on your device.

items.text: The database of the whole school’s marks
items.why: The data of all the pupils is on the server.

items.text: Checking that the password is right
items.why: Passwords are checked by the server, not by your phone.
The look of the screen is handled by the frontend.

items.text: Checking that only a teacher may enter a mark
items.why: The rules for everyone are enforced by the backend.

items.text: Song recommendations based on what millions of people listen to
items.why: Only the server has the data of millions of people.

items.text: The form you type a message into
items.why: You type into it on your own device.

debrief: The frontend talks to you, the backend keeps the data and the rules for everyone. That is why you see the same marks on every device.
